notable_absence.finding: The userspace-CAS workaround (a 'random' tag reread/write retry loop keyed off document identity, not a platform CAS token) is presented explicitly as a stand-in for lack of true CAS support pre-6.6.1/7.0.0 ('this is a can be improved in version 6.6.1 as CAS operations are supported'). The true-CAS variant and its availableSince relation are already captured on the sibling page eventing-handler-advanced-keepLastN.json, so no CAS concept is (re-)minted here - this page is the 'before' half of an already-registered pair.
